description: Returns the read-only SQL that reads what a Supabase database lets people do: tables, whether row level security is on, policies with their roles and conditions, SECURITY DEFINER functions and who may execute them, storage buckets. It is one SELECT over the catalog: it writes nothing and reads no row of data. Run it against the user's database — with a Supabase MCP execute_sql tool if one is connected, or ask the user to run it in their Supabase SQL editor — and pass the JSON it returns to audit_check_snapshot. Show the user the query before running it.
name: audit_snapshot_query
title: Get the read-only query that snapshots a Supabase database
